test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a class there are 40 students (only boys and girls). The number of girls is three-sevenths of the number of boys. Find the number of boys in the class.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since girls are 3/7 of the boys, Ratio of Boys to Girls = 7 : 3

Total units = 7 + 3 = 10 units.

10 units = 40 students ⇒ 1 unit = 4 students.

Number of boys = 7 units = 7 × 4 = 28.

**∴ The correct answer is 28 boys.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of students = 40

Number of girls = 3/7 × Number of boys

 
 

 Total Students = 10 Units = 40

 
 
 Boys (7 Units)

 
 
 Girls (3 Units)

 
 

 Boys = 7 × 4 = 28

 
 

 Girls = 3 × 4 = 12

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number of boys in the class be B.

⇒ The number of girls in the class will be (3/7) × B.

⇒ Total number of students = Boys + Girls = 40

⇒ B + (3/7)B = 40

⇒ (7B + 3B) ÷ 7 = 40

⇒ 10B ÷ 7 = 40

⇒ 10B = 40 × 7

⇒ 10B = 280

⇒ B = 280 ÷ 10 = 28

⇒ The number of boys in the class is 28.

**∴ The correct answer is 28 boys.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fraction to Ratio Rule

If Quantity A is x/y of Quantity B, then the exact ratio of A to B is logically represented as x : y.

Ratio and Proportion

A ratio compares the sizes of two related quantities. The sum of all ratio parts equals the total given quantity, which permits straightforward distribution of a total value.

Unitary Method

This method determines the value of a single foundational unit from a combined multiple-unit value, and multiplies that single unit value to find any required proportion.
